turnaround_reason: Cable/broadband operator collapsed ~65% from highs on persistent internet-sub losses to fixed wireless; trades at ~3x earnings with a transformational Cox merger set to close.
bullish_points: Extreme valuation: forward P/E ~3.3, ~$2.2B FCF; Street mean target implies large upside
Cox merger (~$34.5B) closing summer 2026 adds ~6.5M customers and $800M synergies
Mobile scaling (12M lines) and video losses shrinking fast
Network upgrade narrows the fixed-wireless competitive gap over time
bearish_points: Broadband sub losses ongoing (-120k Q1'26); secular fixed-wireless/fiber pressure
Enormous leverage ($96.7B debt) magnifies any FCF miss
Upgrade capex weighs on near-term FCF
Merger integration risk on top of a soft top line (-1.7%)
catalyst: Cox deal close + evidence broadband net-adds stabilize as synergies/mobile bundle bite
suggested_trade: Spot starter near $145 as deep-value + hard catalyst; see data/research/CHTR.md
key_risk: Broadband erosion accelerates and the FCF/deleveraging story stalls
would_skip_if: Cox synergies disappoint or broadband losses steepen post-close
